subject: Reference and case study: scheduling, substitute, and blackout calendar
messages:

To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Malik <samir@brightbyte.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick reference + case study ask (BrightByte procurement timeline)

Hi Karthik,

Hope you're well — BrightByte is finalizing a vendor shortlist this month and procurement has asked for a short customer reference plus a one-page case study we can include in our internal packet. We spoke with Samir (cc) about a brief call the week of Dec 13 and a short written Q&A they can include in procurement notes.

Can you confirm:
- Is Redwood willing to provide a 20-minute reference call + a 1-page case study that we can circulate to execs?
- Any restrictions on logo use or publishing timing?
- Would you prefer a written Q&A instead of a live call to reduce internal load?

Procurement timeline is tight — they want material by Dec 17. Appreciate a quick flag if this is feasible and who on your side we should coordinate with for consent/sign-off.

Thanks,
Olivia
Director, Strategic Accounts
BrightByte Health

Team — forwarding BrightByte's request. Short window (materials due by Dec 17). A few coordination notes and ask:

1) Reference fatigue: BrightByte was on a reference call for a different prospect two months ago, so we should avoid over-committing the same execs repeatedly.
2) Substitutes: Laura, Marissa — can either of you take the live 20-minute call? If not, Vivek, can you step in as substitute for a quick call or sign the written Q&A?
3) Blackout constraints: If you have conference travel or blackout dates in mid-Dec, please flag them.

If we do a written Q&A + a short follow-up call we can keep asks light and reduce churn for PM/CS. I can own consent and DocuSign routing.

Proposed plan: Marissa does written Q&A (short answers), Laura or Vivek does a 15–20 min follow-up if needed. Let me know availability by EOD today.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- We have a short consent form for logo/quote use; I will route DocuSign today for signature by BrightByte.
